title: Hops On Birch
venue_description:
Flagstaff's Premier Craft Beer Destination

Since 2012 Hops On Birch has established itself as downtown Flagstaff's go-to craft beer bar offering an exceptional selection of 32 constantly rotating taps. The bar focuses heavily on local Arizona breweries and hard-to-find selections from across the United States with specialty cans numbering up to 100 on any given day.

Music and Entertainment

Hops On Birch serves as a vital music venue in Flagstaff's downtown scene. Every Wednesday at 6 PM the venue hosts Musician Open Mic Night featuring host Beth Pickens who creates a chill intimate and supportive environment for local musicians to perform. Sign-ups begin at 5:30 PM. Live music also graces the stage on Saturdays and the first Friday of each month with performances typically starting at 7 PM. The venue provides a quality PA system for performers.

Atmosphere and Community

The bar features a rustic-chic backdrop with an industrial living room vibe complete with cozy ambient lighting. The space includes dart boards games and books encouraging patrons to relax and stay awhile. One of the most beloved features is the outdoor patio which is fully dog-friendly making it a popular gathering spot for locals and visitors alike.

Food and Drink

Beyond the impressive beer selection Hops On Birch also offers wine cider sours seltzers hard kombucha and coffee. The venue allows outside food encouraging guests to pair their craft beverage choices with food from nearby restaurants or downtown food trucks. This flexibility has made it a favorite spot for those seeking the perfect beer and food pairing.

Events and Specials

In addition to regular music programming the bar hosts trivia nights and various community events. The venue has cultivated a reputation for friendly knowledgeable ownership and staff who are passionate about craft beverages and creating a welcoming environment for all guests.

Location and Access

Perfectly positioned in the heart of historic downtown Flagstaff at 22 E Birch Ave the venue is highly accessible on foot and near major attractions boutique shops and dining spots. The bar offers wheelchair accessible seating and maintains a family-friendly policy allowing those under 21 inside until 10 PM.

title: Drinking Horn Mead Hall
venue_description:
Flagstaff's First and Only Meadery

Drinking Horn Meadery was born in the pines of Flagstaff Arizona in 2017 with a mission to create environmentally responsible alcoholic beverages. As Flagstaff's first meadery the venue has introduced Northern Arizona to the traditional roots of mead one of humanity's earliest libations.

Philosophy and Production

The meadery prides itself on sustainability with a focus on water conservation local ingredients and environmentally conscious production methods. Mead is created in small batches using only the best locally sourced ingredients following authentic recipes that honor the drink's ancient heritage from the Pacific Islands.

The Mead Hall Venue

Located at 108 E Route 66 the Mead Hall serves as both a tasting room and community gathering space. The venue features a welcoming atmosphere where guests can enjoy traditionally crafted mead while connecting with others. The space is decorated to reflect the cultural significance of mead and creates a warm inviting environment for patrons.

Live Music and Events

The Mead Hall hosts Open Mic Night every second Tuesday of the month from 6:30-9:30 PM. Sign-ups begin at 6 PM with the first act starting at 6:30. Original music is strongly encouraged and the venue welcomes musicians to bring their instruments and perform. Comedy is not permitted - the focus remains on musical performances. The monthly event has become a gathering point for local musicians seeking a welcoming crowd.

Every Thursday from 7-9 PM the meadery features live Celtic music creating an authentic atmosphere that pairs perfectly with traditional mead. Weekly trivia nights on Wednesdays bring additional community engagement. The venue has also hosted poetry nights goth nights and spiritual gatherings.

Hours and Accessibility

The Mead Hall is open Sunday through Thursday from 11 AM to 10 PM and Friday through Saturday from 11 AM to 11 PM. The location is easily accessible on historic Route 66 in downtown Flagstaff with nearby parking available.

title: AWA Kava Bar
venue_description:
Flagstaff's Premier Kava and Coffee House

AWA Kava Bar opened in late 2019 as Flagstaff's first and only kava bar bringing traditional Pacific Island kava culture to Northern Arizona. The venue serves as an alcohol-free social space focused on community connection and cultural education around kava.

Kava Culture and Offerings

Kava or Piper Methysticum is a plant grown in the central Pacific Islands of Tonga Samoa Vanuatu and Fiji. The root is harvested dried ground and processed into a beverage that has been used culturally for hundreds of years. Kava provides a sense of calm and is sought out for its ability to alleviate anxiety and stress. Many patrons report sleeping better feeling more relaxed enhanced focus and increased willingness to socialize. The venue also offers botanical teas effective for managing chronic pain and sleeping issues along with locally roasted coffee from Toucanet Coffee.

Community and Atmosphere

AWA Kava Bar has formed a tight-knit community of regulars who have found a safe social space through drinking kava. The interior is decorated with local art and filled with board games study areas and comfortable seating creating a homey cafe atmosphere. The venue emphasizes the traditional Pacific Island greeting of Bula welcoming all to experience authentic kava culture.

Live Music and Events

Every Friday at 7:30 PM AWA hosts Open Mic for Musicians providing a platform for local talent to perform in an intimate supportive setting. The acoustic-friendly venue has become known for its music events. Beyond open mic the bar hosts weekly chess nights on Mondays craft nights on Tuesdays and various spiritual and cultural events. The venue's commitment to providing diverse programming has strengthened community bonds.

Mission and Values

Enforcing sobriety is one of the main goals of AWA Kava. The location offers an alternative to traditional bar culture providing a space for social connection without alcohol. This mission has attracted veterans seeking natural alternatives to prescribed medications customers managing anxiety and stress and anyone looking for a healthier social environment.

Hours and Location

Located at 218 S San Francisco Street in downtown Flagstaff AWA Kava Bar is open Sunday through Thursday from 6:30 AM to 10 PM and Friday through Saturday from 6:30 AM to 11 PM. The early morning hours make it popular for coffee and study while evening hours draw the community gathering crowd.

title: Dark Sky Brewing - Beer Garden
venue_description:
Craft Beer Under the Stars

Named in honor of Flagstaff's designation as the world's first International Dark Sky Place Dark Sky Brewing crafts a beer selection as unique and beautiful as every star meteor and comet visible from Flagstaff's pristine night sky. The brewery embodies the connection between craft brewing and the natural beauty of Northern Arizona.

Beer Garden Venue

The outdoor beer garden at 103 W Birch Ave provides an enchanting setting under string lights and open sky. This space has become one of downtown Flagstaff's premier outdoor music venues offering an intimate atmosphere for live performances. The combination of craft beer out-of-this-world pizza and live music creates a memorable experience for locals and visitors.

Live Music Programming

Dark Sky Beer Garden hosts live music every Friday evening from 6-8 PM featuring different musicians each week. The free-entry performances showcase a diverse range of local and regional artists from solo acoustic acts to full bands. The venue has also developed a reputation for special themed events including monthly Acoustic Emo Nights where all-request acoustic emo and pop punk anthems are performed under the stars.

Events and Community

Beyond regular Friday music the brewery hosts the annual Dark Sky Music and Arts Festival a two-day event featuring nonstop live music and an art market with local artisans. Weekly events include trivia nights bingo and yoga sessions. The venue's commitment to community programming and live entertainment has made it a cultural hub in downtown Flagstaff.

Arizona Beer Culture

During Arizona Beer Week Dark Sky participates in collaborative events with other Flagstaff breweries including the release of special collaboration beers. The brewery's dedication to the local craft beer scene and support of Arizona brewing culture strengthens Flagstaff's reputation as a craft beer destination.

Location and Accessibility

Situated in downtown Flagstaff the beer garden benefits from ample street parking and walkability. The outdoor setting and 21+ age requirement create an adult-focused environment perfect for evening entertainment and socializing.

title: The Orpheum Theater
venue_description:
Northern Arizona's Premier Entertainment Venue

The Orpheum Theater in downtown Flagstaff has been offering the best in local and national artists film screenings and community events since 1917. As an independent and locally-owned venue the historic theater combines the intimate feel of a classic building with the capabilities of a modern event space featuring state-of-the-art sound and lighting systems.

Historic Legacy

With over a century of operation The Orpheum Theater stands as a center of community in Flagstaff. Many locals and visitors have precious memories connected to this venue which has hosted everything from live concerts to film festivals. The theater recently celebrated 20 years of continuous live music programming with a special limited-edition merch collection featuring over 200 names of artists who have graced the stage.

Live Music and Performances

The Orpheum hosts concerts across a wide range of genres welcoming artists like Greensky Bluegrass Spafford The Floozies John Craigie and countless others. The venue's 350-person capacity creates an intimate connection between performers and audience. With 15-20 shows scheduled regularly throughout the year the theater serves as the primary mid-sized concert venue for Northern Arizona.

Stage Unity Outdoor Venue

To expand entertainment opportunities The Orpheum has constructed Stage Unity a 16x12 foot outdoor stage on the West wall of the theater. This addition makes it downtown Flagstaff's largest outdoor venue providing new opportunities for live music stand-up comedy community fairs and outdoor group workout sessions. The stage is named after the rainbow mural that adorns the theater's exterior wall.

Programming Diversity

Beyond concerts the venue hosts DJ events hip-hop shows with live accompaniment psychedelic rock reggae-rock and electronic music performances. Local bands like Toxic Positivity Bush League and Tha Yoties regularly perform alongside touring national acts. The diversity of programming ensures there's something for every music taste.

Location and Amenities

Located at 15 W Aspen Ave in the heart of downtown Flagstaff the theater is easily accessible with nearby street parking. The venue maintains professional production capabilities while preserving the charm and character of a historic performance space. Age restrictions vary by show with many events being 18+ or 21+.
